caption: After signup a 10-step setup wizard starts ('Tell us about yourself'); it can be closed straight away with the X.
Dashboard after closing the wizard: 'You have 14 days left on your trial account', with no card entered; the account initials are hidden.
Add New Project: Client is a required field and the selector shows 'No results found' until a client exists; the account initials are hidden.
Add New Client with only a first name filled in: saving fails with 'Please enter valid client information', because a last name is also required; the account initials are hidden.
Project list with our test project P1 for client 'TEST Klant AIBM Test' and the Export to CSV button; the account initials are hidden.
Activation page: Premium billed annually by default, $288.00 base fee plus 1 user at $16.80 a month ($201.60), annual total $489.60; the account initials are hidden.
